open Printf
module T = App_types.Text

type doc_id = T.doc_id

type doc_meta = T.doc_meta = {
  doc_id : doc_id;
  source_doc : T.source_doc;
  revision : int;
  content_hash : string option;
}

type doc_ref = By_locator of App_types.Src_doc.t | By_id of doc_id

type anchor_status = Anchor.anchor_status =
  | Up_to_date of Util.Text_source.t
  | Outdated

type anchor = Anchor.anchor = {
  anchor_id : T.anchor_id;
  doc_id : T.doc_id;
  source_doc : T.source_doc;
  range : T.range;
  raw_contents : string;
  last_author : T.author;
  status : anchor_status;
  needs_review : bool;
}

let create_tables db =
  Sqlite_util.Connect.with_transaction db (fun () ->
      DB.Sources.create_table db;
      DB.Git_sources.create_table db;
      DB.Documents.create_table db;
      DB.Documents_fts.create_table db;
      DB.Documents_fuzzy.create_table db;
      DB.Containers.create_table db;
      DB.Shingles.create_table db;
      DB.Anchors.create_table db)

let source_folder (source : App_types.Text.source) : Fpath.t =
  App_types.Src_doc.resolve_path
    (App_types.Src_doc.of_source_doc_exn { source; locator = "." })

let source_exists db (source : App_types.Text.source) : bool =
  DB.Sources.exists db source

                                                                           
                      
let ensure_source_declared db (source : App_types.Text.source) =
  if source_exists db source then ()
  else
    ksprintf failwith
      "source %s is not declared -- run 'skl source put %s' first"
      (App_types.Source.to_string source)
      (App_types.Source.to_string source)

let put_source db (source : App_types.Text.source) : unit =
  App_types.Source.check_syntax source;
  match source.kind with
  | App_types.Text.Files -> DB.Sources.put db source
  | App_types.Text.Git
  | App_types.Text.Github ->
                                                                                 
      let branch = Util.Git.current_branch (source_folder source) in
      DB.Sources.put db source;
      DB.Git_sources.put db source ~branch

let delete_source db (source : App_types.Text.source) : unit =
  if not (DB.Sources.exists db source) then
    ksprintf failwith "no such source: %s" (App_types.Source.to_string source)
  else if DB.Documents.exists_for_source db source then
    ksprintf failwith
      "%s still has indexed documents -- it can only be deleted once none of \
       its documents are in the database"
      (App_types.Source.to_string source)
  else begin
    DB.Git_sources.delete db source;
    DB.Sources.delete db source
  end

let list_sources db : App_types.Text.source list = DB.Sources.get_all db

type git_source_state = { branch : string; commit : string option }

let get_git_source db (source : App_types.Text.source) :
    git_source_state option =
  DB.Git_sources.get db source
  |> Option.map (fun (branch, commit) -> { branch; commit })

let set_git_source_commit db (source : App_types.Text.source) ~commit : unit =
  DB.Git_sources.set_commit db source ~commit

let count_changed_scm_documents db : int =
  list_sources db
  |> List.fold_left
       (fun total (source : T.source) ->
         match source.kind with
         | Files -> total
         | Git
         | Github ->
             let name = App_types.Source.to_string source in
             let count =
               try
                 let state =
                   match get_git_source db source with
                   | Some state -> state
                   | None -> failwith "missing SCM tracking state"
                 in
                 let root = source_folder source in
                 let branch = Util.Git.current_branch root in
                 if branch <> state.branch then
                   ksprintf failwith
                     "checked out branch %S differs from tracked branch %S"
                     branch state.branch;
                 if not (Util.Git.is_clean root) then
                   failwith
                     "uncommitted changes or untracked files; commit, stash, \
                      or remove them before estimating indexed activity";
                 match state.commit with
                 | None -> List.length (Util.Git.ls_files root)
                 | Some commit ->
                     let head = Util.Git.head_commit root in
                     if not (Util.Git.is_ancestor root ~ancestor:commit head)
                     then
                       failwith
                         "last indexed commit is no longer an ancestor of \
                          HEAD; reconcile source history before estimating \
                          activity";
                     Util.Git.count_changed_files root ~from_commit:commit
               with
               | Failure message ->
                   ksprintf failwith "Cannot measure activity for %s: %s" name
                     message
             in
             if count > max_int - total then
               failwith "SCM activity count overflow";
             total + count)
       0

let get_all_documents db : doc_meta list =
  DB.Documents.get_all db
  |> List.filter_map (fun ((meta : T.doc_meta), contents) ->
      match contents with
      | DB.Deleted -> None
      | DB.Active _ -> Some meta)

let get_document_meta db (src_doc : App_types.Src_doc.t) : doc_meta option =
  let source_doc = App_types.Src_doc.to_source_doc src_doc in
  match
    DB.Documents.get_by_locator db ~source:source_doc.source
      source_doc.locator
  with
  | None -> None
  | Some (meta : T.doc_meta) -> (
      match DB.Documents.get_full_by_id db meta.doc_id with
      | Some (_, DB.Active _) -> Some meta
      | Some (_, DB.Deleted)
      | None ->
          None)

let document_ever_indexed db (src_doc : App_types.Src_doc.t) : bool =
  let source_doc = App_types.Src_doc.to_source_doc src_doc in
  DB.Documents.get_by_locator db ~source:source_doc.source source_doc.locator
  <> None

let get_document db (doc_ref : doc_ref) : doc_meta * Util.Text_source.t =
  let full =
    match doc_ref with
    | By_locator src_doc ->
        let source_doc = App_types.Src_doc.to_source_doc src_doc in
        Option.bind
          (DB.Documents.get_by_locator db ~source:source_doc.source
             source_doc.locator) (fun (meta : T.doc_meta) ->
            DB.Documents.get_full_by_id db meta.doc_id)
    | By_id doc_id -> DB.Documents.get_full_by_id db doc_id
  in
  match full with
  | None ->
      let ref_str =
        match doc_ref with
        | By_locator src_doc -> App_types.Src_doc.show src_doc
        | By_id doc_id -> App_types.Doc_id.to_string doc_id
      in
      ksprintf failwith "Not indexed: %s" ref_str
  | Some (doc_meta, DB.Deleted) ->
      ksprintf failwith
        "Document %s was deleted (see 'skl text document put' to re-add it)"
        (App_types.Src_doc.show_source_doc doc_meta.source_doc)
  | Some (doc_meta, DB.Active contents) ->
      ( doc_meta,
        { Util.Text_source.name = doc_meta.source_doc.locator; contents } )

                                                                   
                                                                 
                                                              
let reindex_and_relocate db ~doc_id ~(contents : DB.doc_contents) :
    doc_meta * anchor list =
  DB.Shingles.delete_doc db doc_id;
  DB.Documents_fuzzy.index db ~doc_id ~contents ~force:false;
  (match contents with
  | DB.Active c -> Anchor.index_shingles db ~doc_id c
  | DB.Deleted -> ());
  let doc_meta =
    match DB.Documents.get_by_id db doc_id with
    | Some m -> m
    | None -> failwith "internal error: just-registered document not found"
  in
  let changed =
    Anchor.relocate_stale_anchors db ~doc_id ~doc_revision:doc_meta.revision
  in
  (doc_meta, changed)

let add_file db (src_doc : App_types.Src_doc.t)
    (text_source : Util.Text_source.t) : doc_meta * anchor list =
  let source_doc = App_types.Src_doc.to_source_doc src_doc in
  Sqlite_util.Connect.with_transaction db (fun () ->
      ensure_source_declared db source_doc.source;
      let doc_id =
        DB.Documents.create_or_update db ~source:source_doc.source
          ~locator:source_doc.locator
          ~contents:(DB.Active text_source.contents)
      in
      DB.Containers.index db ~doc_id src_doc;
      reindex_and_relocate db ~doc_id
        ~contents:(DB.Active text_source.contents))

let remove_document ?(strict = false) db (doc_ref : doc_ref) : anchor list =
  let doc_meta =
    match doc_ref with
    | By_locator src_doc ->
        let source_doc = App_types.Src_doc.to_source_doc src_doc in
        DB.Documents.get_by_locator db ~source:source_doc.source
          source_doc.locator
    | By_id doc_id -> DB.Documents.get_by_id db doc_id
  in
  match doc_meta with
  | None ->
      if strict then
        let ref_str =
          match doc_ref with
          | By_locator src_doc -> App_types.Src_doc.show src_doc
          | By_id doc_id -> App_types.Doc_id.to_string doc_id
        in
        ksprintf failwith "Not indexed: %s" ref_str
      else []
  | Some (meta : T.doc_meta) ->
      Sqlite_util.Connect.with_transaction db (fun () ->
          let doc_id =
            DB.Documents.create_or_update db ~source:meta.source_doc.source
              ~locator:meta.source_doc.locator ~contents:DB.Deleted
          in
          DB.Containers.delete_for_doc db doc_id;
          snd (reindex_and_relocate db ~doc_id ~contents:DB.Deleted))

                                                                               
let reindex_all db : int =
  Sqlite_util.Connect.with_transaction db (fun () ->
      let docs = DB.Documents.get_all db in
      List.iter
        (fun ((doc_meta : T.doc_meta), contents) ->
          DB.Shingles.delete_doc db doc_meta.doc_id;
          DB.Documents_fuzzy.index db ~doc_id:doc_meta.doc_id ~contents
            ~force:true;
          match contents with
          | DB.Active c -> Anchor.index_shingles db ~doc_id:doc_meta.doc_id c
          | DB.Deleted ->                                          ())
        docs;
      List.length docs)

let add_anchor = Anchor.add_anchor
let delete_anchor = Anchor.delete_anchor
let get_anchor = Anchor.get_anchor
let get_anchors = Anchor.get_anchors
let get_all_anchors = Anchor.get_all_anchors
let get_all_current_anchors = Anchor.get_all_current_anchors
let get_all_stale_anchors = Anchor.get_all_stale_anchors

let report_source_error ~had_error (source : App_types.Text.source) msg =
  had_error := true;
  Util.Log.printf "Error updating %s: %s"
    (App_types.Source.to_string source)
    msg;
  eprintf "Error updating %s: %s\n%!"
    (App_types.Source.to_string source)
    (Util.Text.sanitize_block msg)

let run _common db max_file_bytes strict force source =
  DB.Admin.with_db (File db) @@ fun db ->
  match source with
  | Some source -> update_one_source db ~max_file_bytes ~strict ~force source
  | None -> (
      match Text.list_sources db with
      | [] ->
          Run.usage_error
            "no source is declared -- run 'skl source put' first, or pass \
             --source explicitly"
      | sources ->
          let had_error = ref false in
          List.iteri
            (fun i source ->
              if i > 0 then print_newline ();
              printf "== %s ==\n%!" (App_types.Source.to_string source);
              if strict then
                update_one_source db ~max_file_bytes ~strict ~force source
              else
                match
                  update_one_source db ~max_file_bytes ~strict ~force source
                with
                | () -> ()
                | exception Run.Usage_error msg ->
                    report_source_error ~had_error source msg
                | exception Failure msg ->
                    report_source_error ~had_error source msg)
            sources;
          if !had_error then
            failwith "one or more sources failed to update (see errors above)"
      )

let doc =
  "Add, update, and delete documents in bulk, to match exactly what's \
   currently found at --source, or at every declared source in turn if \
   --source is omitted."

let man =
  [
    `S Manpage.s_description;
    `P
      "If given, --source must already be declared (see 'skl source put \
       --overview'); if omitted, every currently declared source is updated \
       in turn instead -- there is no default/implicit source -- failing if \
       none are declared at all (see OUTPUT FORMAT below for how multiple \
       sources are reported). Either way, for each source, the current file \
       list is discovered fresh from it, the same way for every source kind: \
       for a $(b,git:)/$(b,github:) source, every file $(b,git ls-files) \
       currently reports as tracked; for a $(b,files:)$(i,NAME) source, \
       every regular file or symlink found by walking its directory tree. \
       There is no other way to feed this command a file list (e.g. no \
       reading paths from stdin): the whole point is that it always reflects \
       each source's own current state, not a list the caller has to keep in \
       sync by hand.";
    `P
      "For a $(b,git:)/$(b,github:) source that was already successfully \
       updated at least once, this instead touches only what $(b,git diff) \
       reports as changed since that update's own commit -- much cheaper \
       than re-reading and re-hashing every tracked file -- after checking \
       that the branch currently checked out at the source's own folder \
       still matches the one it's declared to track, and that the commit it \
       was last updated at is still part of that branch's history (not true \
       after e.g. a rebase); otherwise, or on a brand new source, every \
       currently tracked/found file is touched, the same as a $(b,files:) \
       source always is. See $(b,--force) for what happens when that \
       commit's history check fails.";
    `P
      "Either way, every discovered (or, for an incremental \
       $(b,git:)/$(b,github:) update, changed) path is added or refreshed \
       (reusing its doc ID if already indexed). The database only ever \
       reflects what's currently readable at --source: every document \
       already indexed under it whose path wasn't found at all this run (or, \
       incrementally, was reported deleted/renamed away), and every path \
       that WAS found but whose contents couldn't be obtained (see the next \
       paragraph for what that means), is deindexed (soft-deleted) just the \
       same -- a failure to read a file this run is treated as proof it's \
       gone, not as a transient hiccup to wait out.";
    `P
      "A path that is itself a symlink is always skipped (left indexed/ \
       deindexed exactly as if it hadn't been found at all), whether it's a \
       broken symlink or points at a file or a directory, and whether it was \
       reported by $(b,git ls-files)/$(b,git diff) or found while walking a \
       $(b,files:) source's directory tree. There is no option to index \
       through one: doing so could silently pull content from outside \
       --source's own root.";
    `P
      "A file that can't be indexed (e.g. over $(b,--max-file-bytes), \
       unreadable, or not well-formed, non-minified UTF-8 text) doesn't stop \
       the rest of the batch: it's logged as a warning and counted, and \
       processing continues (see above for what happens to that file's own \
       document -- deindexed, same as if it had vanished outright). With \
       $(b,--strict), this is a fatal error instead: the whole batch aborts \
       immediately and nothing from it is committed, including any \
       deindexing or progress recorded for a $(b,git:)/$(b,github:) source. \
       (An anchor that fails to relocate -- its text edited beyond \
       recognition, deleted, ... -- is not a warning: that's a normal part \
       of the corpus's lifecycle, already reported as the anchor going \
       $(b,Outdated); see the $(b,Newly orphaned anchors) section below.)";
    `P
      "Checking out the right branch and commit at --source's own folder is \
       always the caller's job: this command only ever reads what's \
       currently there, never runs $(b,git checkout)/$(b,git fetch)/etc. \
       itself.";
    `S "OUTPUT FORMAT";
    `P
      "When --source is omitted (every declared source is updated), each \
       source's own report, exactly as described below, is preceded by a \
       lone $(b,== KIND:NAME ==) line. Without $(b,--strict), a source that \
       fails (e.g. a dirty git working tree) doesn't stop the others: its \
       error is printed in its place and the next source is still attempted, \
       but the command still exits with a nonzero status once every source \
       has been tried. With $(b,--strict), the first source to fail stops \
       the whole run immediately instead, the same as a single file's \
       failure does within one source (see below) -- no source after it is \
       even attempted.";
    `P
      "A one-line recap comes first: $(b,Documents:) how many $(i,new) \
       (never indexed under this source before), $(i,updated) (already \
       indexed, or re-added after being deindexed), and $(i,deleted) \
       (deindexed by this run) documents were processed, and their total. \
       $(b,Warnings:) is the count of warnings logged during the run (each \
       one is also printed as it happens, as $(b,Warning: ) followed by its \
       message).";
    `P
      "If any symlinks were skipped, a $(b,Skipped symlinks) section comes \
       next, listing them one path per line. Then three sections, each in \
       the same one-line-per-anchor format as 'skl text anchors list' \
       ($(b,D)/$(b,A), anchor ID, byte range, document path): $(b,Relocated \
       anchors) lists every anchor that moved (in this or an earlier batch \
       line) to a new location as a result of this batch, and needs review; \
       $(b,Unorphaned anchors) lists every anchor that was stale before this \
       batch ran but is no longer stale afterward; $(b,Newly orphaned \
       anchors) lists every anchor that was up to date before this batch ran \
       but could not be relocated by it. All three sections report their \
       count even when empty.";
    `P

item.text:
I found two **P0** anchor relocation issues:

- **An anchor can silently move to the wrong document.** Candidates are ranked by shingle coverage and hit count, then by lowest document ID; the original document gets no preference ([Anchor.ml](/workspace/kb-research/samples/skeletor/skeletor-stripped-comments-markdown/base-libs/text/Anchor.ml:348)). If two files contain the same anchored text and the original file changes elsewhere, relocation can move the anchor to the older indexed copy even though its text remains in the original file. The anchor then appears up to date while pointing at the wrong evidence.

- **A move between edited files can be missed permanently.** Each file’s anchors are relocated immediately after that file is indexed ([Text.ml](/workspace/kb-research/samples/skeletor/skeletor-stripped-comments-markdown/base-libs/text/Text.ml:199)), while bulk updates index files one at a time ([Documents_update_cmd.ml](/workspace/kb-research/samples/skeletor/skeletor-stripped-comments-markdown/cli/Documents_update_cmd.ml:438)). If the old file is processed before the destination, its new text is absent from the index and the attempt fails. Failed anchors are retried only when their original document’s revision increases ([DB.ml](/workspace/kb-research/samples/skeletor/skeletor-stripped-comments-markdown/base-libs/text/DB.ml:852)); indexing the destination later does not retry them.
